subject: Acme Inc. POC kickoff recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmeinc.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Inc. POC kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Liam / Sofia —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps to get the POC kicked off next week. Please reply if I missed anything.

Summary / pain points:
- Current internal search results are slow and often return irrelevant documents; users report low satisfaction.
- High per-query cost on the incumbent vector DB + model setup; want predictable unit economics.
- Need strict data controls and auditability for customer data (HIPAA consideration called out).

POC goal / success metrics:
- Improve top-3 result relevance by +15% on our evaluation prompts (measured by Acme's raters).
- Achieve median inference latency < 350ms at 99th percentile for the demo traffic profile.
- Demonstrate 30% cost reduction per 1k queries versus current setup (using Redwood batching + cache).

Scope & timeline:
- Scope: 2-week technical POC (development sandbox) followed by a 4-week production pilot.
- Kickoff (internal + Acme): target Wed May 5 — 30–45m alignment, access checks, and data transfer plan.
- POC duration: May 6–May 20.

Owners / responsibilities:
- Acme: Liam (POC lead) — provide sample prompt set, representative queries, and test data access.
- Redwood: Marissa (engagement lead) — commercial/coordination; Aditya (solutions) — provisioning & infra; Rishi (SRE/SE) — model/eval setup + prompt set support.

Immediate action items (by EOD Monday):
1) Acme to confirm which dataset can be shared to the Redwood sandbox and provide a HubSpot record / contact for procurement (procurement@acmeinc.com listed).
2) Redwood to share POC scope doc and access checklist (attached).
3) Rishi to prepare the initial prompt/eval template and a short checklist for embedding/index access.

Attachments: redwood-poc-scope.xlsx (POC scope + milestones), access-checklist.md (data & account setup)

Thanks again — excited to get started.
—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
[Attachment: redwood-poc-scope.xlsx] [Attachment: access-checklist.md]

Hi all —

Quick update from the engineering side ahead of the kickoff:
- Rishi has prepared an initial prompt/eval template (attached) that mirrors Acme's top query types — includes ranking prompts, reranking examples, and relevance labels.
- Sandbox provisioning checklist: I verified the sandbox instance can be set up with isolated S3 bucket, VPC peering, and KMS-backed keys. I'll share the runbook during the kickoff.

3) Stand up sandbox and add Acme's test service account (once they share the service account email).

I'll plan to join May 5 at 11:00 PT. Marissa — please send the invite and I'll add the runbook to the Drive.
